summary_1line: Vidura instructs on hospitality, ethical conduct, secrecy in governance, wise counsel, and prudent rulership to maintain order and prosperity.

image_candidates.scene_text: A humble householder washes the dusty feet of a visiting Brahmana while offering water, honey, and curds in welcome.
A king stands on a lonely palace terrace at night, whispering state secrets only to a trusted minister while spies gather distant whispers.
A serene forest ascetic tends a small sacred fire beside his hut as unexpected guests arrive among the trees.
